title: coreopsis crassifolia
intro: Coreopsis crassifolia, commonly known as stiff tickseed, is a plant species that belongs to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, wounds, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Coreopsis crassifolia include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and act as an antiseptic agent. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
